title: 第十五章 挑战第十六章 完胜第十七章 大比一
content_zh:
秦凤鸣双腿跪地，双手接过师傅赠与的宝剑，满面激动之色道：“弟子以后一定勤学剑法，用此剑除魔卫道，伸张正义，不给师门抹黑。”
张堂主夫妇都欣慰点头，摆手让他离去，秦凤鸣又给师傅师娘磕了一个头，才拜别师傅向自己住所走去。
就这样，以后半月之内，秦凤鸣把整套飘柳十三式剑法招数学习了一遍，但是要说精通，那肯定是谈不到的。
之后的每日，秦凤鸣都到丹云峰后山的僻静之处习练剑法。
晚上之时，则打坐习练那口诀。
在这时日之内，师傅也时常指点其轻功口诀的修行。
秦凤鸣现在在跳跃之时，身子轻灵异常。
半丈高的大石，轻轻一跳，就能轻飘飘的落到上面。
想来就如小师姐若彤般跳跃也指日可待了。
学习完整套剑法后，秦凤鸣勤奋更甚，每日天蒙蒙亮就去后山练武，天黑之后才回来。
段猛和袁克俭二人同样刻苦，他们也各自找了一个僻静所在，勤练张堂主交给的秘笈。
尽管三人住在同一院落之中，但是见面的机会却越来越少。
但每次见袁克俭之时，秦凤鸣就自觉察，其看自己眼神充满敌意，但仔细想来，自己从来未曾得罪过他，实在想不明白原因出在何处。
暗自摇摇头之下，秦凤鸣也只有将之束之高阁，不再理会。
转眼，一年时间已过，秦凤鸣每日除去勤练剑法，就是打坐修习那篇内功。
闲暇之时，也会拿出那个葫芦把玩，直到此时，那个葫芦也毫无变化。
每次，他都会用力扭动一下那盖子，但每次都会失望，那盖子如同长在上面一般，纹丝不动。
他还时不时去百丈崖给师傅师娘请安。
有时还和小师姐比试一番。
师姐对他进步之神速，却也惊讶非常，仅一年时间，二人就已打的互有攻守。

在此一年之内，秦凤鸣也分别见过了两位师兄。
大师兄杨澜，长得高大威武，面色黑紫，年纪在二十二三岁。
二师兄吕轩，却生得英俊潇洒，目似朗星，年岁在十**间，打冷眼观瞧，与师傅到有几分神似之处。
秦凤鸣也自发现，小师姐对二师兄异常亲热。
对待大师兄只是礼貌问候。
对于秦凤鸣，两位师兄甚是欢喜。
content_en:
Qin Fengming knelt on his knees, took the sword given by his master with both hands, and said with excitement on his face: "Disciple must study swordsmanship diligently in the future, use this sword to eliminate demons, defend the law, uphold justice, and not bring discredit to the master."
Hall Master Zhang and his wife both nodded happily and waved for him to leave. Qin Fengming kowtowed to the master and his wife again before bidding farewell to the master and walking to his residence.
In this way, within the next half month, Qin Fengming learned the entire set of Piaoliu's Thirteen Styles of Swordsmanship, but to be proficient in it, it was definitely out of the question.
Every day after that, Qin Fengming went to a secluded place in the back mountain of Danyun Peak to practice his sword skills.
In the evening, I meditate and practice the mantra.
During this period, the master often gave guidance on the practice of Qing Gong formulas.
Qin Fengming's body is extremely light and agile when he is jumping now.
The half-foot-high boulder can easily fall to the top with a slight jump.
Thinking about it, it will be just around the corner to be able to jump like little senior sister Ruotong.
After learning a complete set of swordsmanship, Qin Fengming became even more diligent. He would go to the back mountain to practice martial arts every day at dawn and only come back after dark.
Duan Meng and Yuan Kejian worked equally hard. They each found a secluded place to practice the secrets given by Hall Master Zhang.
Although the three of them live in the same compound, the chances of meeting each other are becoming less and less.
But every time he saw Yuan Kejian, Qin Fengming realized that his eyes were full of hostility, but when he thought about it carefully, he had never offended him, and he really couldn't figure out the reason.
Shaking his head secretly, Qin Fengming could only put it away and ignore it.
In the blink of an eye, one year has passed. Qin Fengming, apart from diligently practicing swordsmanship, spends every day meditating to practice his inner strength.
In my spare time, I would take out the gourd and play with it. Until now, the gourd had not changed.
Every time, he would twist the cover hard, but he would be disappointed every time. The cover seemed to be growing on it and would not move at all.
He also went to Baizhangya from time to time to pay his respects to his master and his wife.
Sometimes I even compete with my junior sister.
The senior sister was very surprised by his rapid progress. In just one year, the two of them were already fighting each other's offense and defense.
Within this year, Qin Fengming also met two senior brothers respectively.
Senior brother Yang Lan is tall and mighty, with a dark-purple complexion, and is twenty-two or three years old.
The second senior brother, Lu Xuan, is handsome and handsome, with eyes like bright stars. He is about ten years old. Looking at him with a cold eye, he has some similarities with his master.
Qin Fengming also discovered that the young senior sister was extremely affectionate to the second senior brother.
Treat senior brother with just polite greetings.
The two senior brothers were very happy for Qin Fengming.
